common_name: Palearctic Latitudinal Wing-Size Cline Fly (50-Year Global Bergmann Cline)

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila subobscura (3.0 µm, detail scale)

predecessor.note: Cellular-scale pigment stripe of the melanogaster-subgroup sister. Kinetics are not copied; only this wavelength enters the wavenumber ratio.

successor.note: Wing-spot melanin scale of the suzukii–biarmipes clade. Kinetics are not copied.

same_species_other_scale.note: Primordium-scale sibling. This slot is the 3.0 µm detail variant and does not reuse its power-law parameters.

governing_model.name: Schnakenberg reaction-diffusion on a periodic cuticle patch

equations.reaction_diffusion: du/dt = a - u + u^2 v + Du ∇²u ; dv/dt = b - u^2 v + Dv ∇²v
equations.dispersion_determinant: det(J - k^2 D) = Du Dv k^4 - (Dv f_u + Du g_v) k^2 + (f_u g_v - f_v g_u)
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (Dv f_u + Du g_v) / (2 Du Dv)
equations.physical_pin: The nondimensional wavelength is scaled so lambda_c maps to 2.97e-6 m.

governing_model.boundary_conditions: Periodic (2-torus) on a square patch whose side is 6 critical wavelengths (17.82 µm). This is the two-dimensional extension of Turing's isolated ring: no external morphogen flux, pattern selected by the intrinsic wavenumber.
instability_conditions: (Dv f_u + Du g_v)^2 > 4 Du Dv det(J)

parameters.note: Du and Dv are in units of 10^-3 in the Lean diffusion product (41 × 530). They are not the alpha/beta power-law coefficients of slots 2701, 2781, or 2901.

empirical_claims.claim: In ancestral Old World Drosophila subobscura, wing length increases clinally with latitude. In North America no wing-length cline was detected one decade after introduction; after two decades a cline had evolved and largely converged on the ancestral cline.
South American populations, founded in the late 1970s, likewise evolved a positive latitudinal wing-size cline.
A homogeneous morphogen field can be unstable to a finite band of wavenumbers, so a characteristic wavelength is selected.

transfer_boundary: Huey, Gilchrist and coauthors measured wing length, not a 3 µm pigment lattice. The 3.0 µm wavelength is the assigned subcellular detail scale for this loop. Applying k_c at that scale is a reconstruction, not a result reported by those papers.

specimen.creator: Martin Cooper
specimen.locality: Ipswich, Suffolk, England, near Christchurch Park
specimen.identification: Male Drosophila subobscura; Paul Beuk confirmed the obscura-group diagnosis (single large seta on the palpus).
